posts.headline: Twenty-one editions deep and Thicks is still the lone unbeaten contender at 4-0, but with a 14-14 career mark and a 5.5 average finish, that ring is starting to feel like a lottery ticket, not a dynasty.
posts.detail: 530.16 points through four weeks is fine, not scary — this league has seen Tyrique14 finish as low as 8th before, so the title defense talk needs a real test before I buy in.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 0-4 disaster is now mathematically impossible to explain away given a 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish — this is the greatest fraud season in league history.
posts.detail: 453.58 points scored says the roster isn't the problem, which means adambarner111 himself might be the malfunction, and that Cal Berkeley degree isn't fixing a winless record.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh drops to 1-3 and the name keeps cashing in — a 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12 average finish is the definition of truth in advertising.
posts.detail: 444.18 points for and still barely above the bottom-feeder floor, this roster is the living punchline to W.E.B. Du Bois's irony.

posts.headline: Sasinci sits stuck at 2-2 and even with a ring in the case, Big Head's 13-15 career mark keeps this title defense looking shakier than the Milk Man's falsetto.
posts.detail: 491.06 points is middling at best for a so-called contender, and a 5.5 average finish says the pedigree is more myth than muscle at this point.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers remain the ONLY 4-0 team in the league with a gaudy 622.86 points, and this league still refuses to crown triciagloston as the real threat she is.
posts.detail: A modest 6-7-1 career record be damned — nobody else in Busters Anonymous is scoring like this right now, and sleeping on a 4-0 start is how upsets get made..
